summary: Iteration 5 backend + frontend tested. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (test_iteration5.py) — incident create/get/patch (status/root_cause/note/title), timeline entries, evidence aggregation/dedup, link/unlink alerts (with 400 for unknown, 404 for not-linked), status validation (422 on Bogus), legacy incident backfills, alert.linked_incidents populated, alert lifecycle unchanged (New/Under Review/Investigating/Confirmed/False Positive/Resolved), 10 rules R001-R010 unchanged, saved-searches per-user CRUD + 409 on dup + 404 on cross-user delete, audit rows for create_incident/update_incident/link_alerts/unlink_alert with actor=admin. Frontend UI verified: incidents list, incident drawer (status-select w/ all 4 statuses including Resolved, root-cause save, note save, timeline block reverse-chrono, alerts block w/ unlink), alerts drawer link-incident-select/btn + linked-incidents block populates after linking (toast 'Alert linked to incident' seen), Explorer save-search dialog + saved-searches strip + chip apply/delete all present. Two frontend gaps found on Incidents page: (1) NO 'New incident' button (data-testid='new-incident-btn') is rendered — the `newOpen` state and new-incident dialog exist in code but there's no visible trigger, so the create-incident flow is unreachable from the Incidents page UI. (2) NO status filter control (data-testid='incident-status-filter') rendered even though `statusFilter` state exists.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'New incident' button (data-testid='new-incident-btn') required by the spec is NOT rendered. `newOpen` state + full new-incident-dialog exist in JSX (lines 302-354) but there is no button/PageHeader-right slot that calls setNewOpen(true). Users can only create incidents by escalating from an alert. Add a Button in the page header (e.g., <PageHeader right={<Button data-testid='new-incident-btn' onClick={()=>setNewOpen(true)}>New incident</Button>} />).

Status filter is unusable — `statusFilter` state (line 35) is declared and its value is used to build /incidents?status= query, but no <Select data-testid='incident-status-filter'> is rendered. Users cannot filter incidents by status via the UI.

action_items: Incidents.jsx: render a 'New incident' button with data-testid='new-incident-btn' that calls setNewOpen(true) (e.g., in PageHeader right slot).
Incidents.jsx: render a status filter Select with data-testid='incident-status-filter' (options: all/Open/Investigating/Resolved/Closed) bound to statusFilter.
critical_code_review_comments: Incidents.jsx has orphaned state — `newOpen`/`setNewOpen` and `statusFilter`/`setStatusFilter` are declared but no UI element ever toggles them. Confirms this was an incomplete render, not intentional API-only.

server.py update_incident: the `if len(updates) == 1 and not push_notes and not timeline_entries` guard (line 730) correctly rejects empty PATCH but is fragile — relies on updated_at being the only key. Consider tracking a real 'anything_changed' flag.

server.py get_incident backfills root_cause+timeline in the response only (line 625-626) — the underlying document is not persisted. This is fine for reads but any subsequent PATCH that references timeline[-1] would still see missing field on the doc. In practice the code uses $push which auto-creates arrays, so OK.
server.py create_incident evidence dedup uses `list(dict.fromkeys(...))` (line 669) — good. link_alerts uses $addToSet which also dedups. Consistent.
server.py list_incidents returns full docs including notes/timeline arrays — for large incidents this could be heavy. Consider excluding notes/timeline from list and only including on detail GET.
server.py saved_searches unique index is on (owner, name) — correct. But POST returns 409 with a generic message; would be nicer to say which name already exists.
Explorer.jsx applySaved sets q/severity/appName then relies on the `[severity, appName]` useEffect to reload — good. But saved.filters may omit `q` and then setQ('') resets — expected.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (drawer, alerts-link, explorer saved-searches all work; new-incident-btn and incident-status-filter missing)

To rerun, safe. Only two UI gaps remain: missing new-incident-btn and incident-status-filter on Incidents page — both are pure render additions in Incidents.jsx.
rca of the issue: Missing new-incident-btn: developer added the dialog + form + state (newOpen, newForm, createIncident) in Incidents.jsx but forgot to wire a trigger button. Reproduction: navigate to /incidents as admin — no visible 'New incident' CTA, and querySelector('[data-testid=new-incident-btn]') returns null. Same pattern for status filter. Mitigation: add a Button in PageHeader's right prop that calls setNewOpen(true), and add a Select bound to statusFilter next to the incident list header.
